notes.title: v0.5.0 is live! - Level Editor!
notes.notes:
With this version we are finally maknig our level editor accessible to the community! It still needs some polish round the edges but we would love to see what the community can create. Come along to our discord server to share levels and see who can get the fastest time!

In future updates we will be integrating steam workshop support for easily sharing levels with everyone. We will also be adding leaderboard support on these published levels.

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Neon Shift - Level Editor Showcase
notes.notes: Watch us design some levels for Neon Shift and test some levels from the community! We'll also be happy to answer any questions or jsut to chat about our upcoming release.

notes.title: v0.4.0 Released!
notes.notes:
v0.4.0 is now live! We've made a lot of progress and have puublished 5 new levels for players to enjoy!

These levels were created using our custom level editing tool which will be released in an upcoming version for Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: Demo v0.3.1 released!
notes.notes:
Small whoopsie on my part with how leaderboards work in demo builds. Have released a quick fix today which should address the issues. 

We are of some issues to do with menu layouts/scaling on certain monitor sizes and are looking into it for the next patch.
